text:
Leah: hey team — pinging runtime/infra/sec for quick eyes on PR #42189. touches routing policy + KV prefix cache + a small KMS integration change. want to merge tomorrow morning if no blockers :wave:

Dmitri: can you paste the diff for the routing bits? i can eyeball perf/regressions quickly

Leah: sure — main change is a new routing filter that prefers local caches for warm prefixes, fallback to remote pool. snippet:
```
if (cache.hasPrefix(req.prefix)) {
  route = localPool;
} else {
  route = remotePool.fallback(req);
}
```

Raj: infra here. my main ask: does this change the eviction semantics? looks like it could increase pinned KV lifetimes under heavy load. need to know if we bumped any mem limits

Leah: good call. eviction unchanged — we added a soft-ttl for cached prefixes (30s) to reduce churn. no mem limit changes in this PR. test load at 1k qps shows stable RSS in staging.

Anna: security — the KMS touchpoint: PR adds an optional key ID that gets passed through to a decrypt call. Is key selection deterministic from the request or user-specified? we need to confirm no escalation path. :eyes:

Leah: KMS change is opt-in for internal customers only. key ID comes from service-config (tenant-scoped), not user input. i can add an assertion and a small note in the runbook.

Dmitri: quick perf note — the routing check is O(1) but we should microbenchmark with cold-started seq lengths. can run a 30-min perf job if helpful.

Leah: yes please run it if you have time. otherwise we can merge behind a canary that routes 5% traffic to the new path.

Raj: i can review infra bits and approve by EOD if you add the runbook note and a short mem/ttl summary in the PR description.

Anna: add a unit test asserting KMS key source + a short section in the security checklist. then i can sign off.

Leah: will update PR with: 1) runbook blurb, 2) mem/ttl summary, 3) kms unit test. canary plan: 5% for 2 hours, monitor token latency and eviction rate.

ci-bot: PR #42189 — build passed (unit + linters), integration queued (staging).

Dmitri: thanks — i'll kick off the microbenchmark, will post numbers in the PR thread.

Leah: awesome. tagging @Raj @Anna — trying to land tomorrow AM. LMK if timeline conflicts. :thumbsup:
